8244.title: Plugin fence boot transition exposes source and changes layout
8244.rootCauseOneLine: Fence resolution only enumerates currently registered languages and discards remembered ownership; the host has no prior-size reservation, so reopening renders raw code until registration replaces it with the card.

prReviews.verdict: Static mechanism aligned; execution not performed
prReviews.topFinding: Pending ownership and width-matched box retention target the verified host transition; linked branch not run.

8244.proposedFix: Retain known renderer ownership through boot and reserve an appropriately keyed, width-compatible prior box with safe fallback after plugins settle.
8244.caveats: Component-level transition repeated twice; full timeline bottom pinning, third-party plugin behavior, mobile timings, and reported jump magnitudes were not reproduced. Existing open PR #8245 prevents a duplicate fix.
